contents_summary: Additional file 1 (DOCX): Tables S1 to S3, one per case, each listing per admission the ICD-10 diagnosis, clinical description, medication during recording, optional comments and 24-hour actigraphy variables (mean activity count, SD in %, RMSSD in %, RMSSD/SD). All 36 text units were read; no embedded images, charts or workbooks are present.

limitations: Supplement MOESM1 scope only; coverage is an annotator assertion about the reviewed supplement text, not machine verification.
Facts take their column from the printed column order (1st, 2nd, 3rd admission); quotes repeated across columns (for example identical diagnoses) do not carry the column by themselves.
Row labels give no unit for mean activity count or RMSSD/SD; the Methods text says counts per minute but no unit is entered here.
Case 2 has an empty fifth column that was not transcribed as data; empty comment cells are not findings.
Doses are listed in the medication-during-recording cell; no frequency or route is printed.
